card.name: Linking words in clinical sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, or, in, with, into, be) that come right after a medical phrase and lead into the next clinical item. Most often the word 'and' after a list such as 'hepatic, renal, or cardiac function,' in the elderly-dosing statement.

modes.label: 'and' after organ function list
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'decreased hepatic, renal, or cardiac function,' in the geriatric dosing paragraph.
modes.example: reflecting the greater frequency of decreased hepatic, renal, or cardiac function,<< and>> of concomitant disease or other drug

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Short words such as in, or, with, into or be that join a clinical term to what follows.
modes.example: Reduce infusion rate, interrupt infusion<< or>> permanently discontinue GAZYVA for I
